problem: the receipt says 'these bytes were reviewed, here is their SHA-256'; until now only a human with a browser could check that claim
solution: a script that reads the reviewed digest out of the receipt HTML and recomputes the file's

interface.mismatch: exit 1, prints both digests and says to re-review the current bytes
interface.unreadableOrPending: exit 2, with a message that a receipt exported before any decision has nothing to verify
interface.printOnly: --print emits the digest, for scripts that want the value

whyExitCodes: a receipt check that cannot gate a CI job is a formality; 0/1/2 is what a test runner uses

cases: matching file passes and the digest prints
changed file exits 1 with both digests
a pending receipt exits 2 with an explanation

notDone: the script does not verify that the receipt was produced by this plugin or check any signature — it compares bytes to a digest, which is all the receipt claims
